method: membrane-kv-runtime-relocate-probe 'multi_retire' mode (new this phase): relocate a deterministic, predeclared group of N layers CPU->GPU (llama_synchronize before each call), invalidate_graph_cache ONCE after the whole group, decode+generate; then relocate the SAME group back GPU->CPU (real free attempted for each, since every layer's SECOND move now targets its own dedicated backing), invalidate_graph_cache ONCE, decode+generate. No adaptive scheduling -- the group membership is a fixed, predeclared list.
conclusion: A SINGLE llama_invalidate_graph_cache() call correctly covers an entire batch of relocations, not just one layer at a time -- VRAM reclamation scales cleanly with group size (6/9/15/28 MiB for 1/2/4/8 layers).
